title: The rename left an untracked plugins/core in old checkouts
what: After the rename to relay@amidman (28 Oct, e307a40) every checkout that existed before it keeps an untracked plugins/core/ (only .pyc caches and plugins/core/tests/ts-deps/node_modules, about 25 MB). __pycache__ is ignored, node_modules at that path is not, so `git status` shows `?? plugins/core/` in the main checkout and the gate of wt/no-numbers refused ("commit first: the gate must run on a commit"). guard-main refuses `git clean` in the main checkout, and the auto-mode classifier refused `rm -rf` for an agent.
why: A dirty main checkout breaks the rule that it stays clean and turns gates red in old worktrees. Ignoring node_modules/ everywhere (each ts-deps folder is regenerated by bun) makes the leftover invisible without deleting anything by hand.
pass_cases: .gitignore ignores node_modules/ at any depth; `git status` in a checkout with the leftover folder is clean.
relay doctor names a leftover folder of a renamed plugin and the command that removes it.
